cues: Recursion is a function calling itself.
Every recursive function needs a base case that stops it, and a recursive case that moves towards it.
It needs factorial of three, which needs factorial of two, which needs factorial of one: the base case.
Each waiting call sits on the stack.
text: Recursion is a function calling itself. Every recursive function needs a base case that stops it, and a recursive case that moves towards it. Call factorial of four. It needs factorial of three, which needs factorial of two, which needs factorial of one: the base case. Each waiting call sits on the stack.
